# MapOverlay

A positioned surface that floats product chrome above the map canvas.

- **Import:** `import { MapOverlay } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** SDK
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/map-mapoverlay--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { MapOverlay, POICard, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function MapOverlayExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <div className="relative h-[480px] bg-muted overflow-hidden rounded-container border">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Map SDK renderer slot
        </div>
        <MapOverlay position="top-left">
          <POICard
            title="Gate A12"
            subtitle="Departures"
            description="Overlay content remains interactive while the map remains pannable outside the content bounds."
          />
        </MapOverlay>
      </div>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## MapOverlay

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `MapOverlayProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

- `position`: `"top-left" | "top-right" | "bottom-left" | "bottom-right" | "top-start" | "top-end" | "bottom-start" | "bottom-end" | "top-center" | "bottom-center"`, optional, default `"top-left"`.

  Use start/end corners to mirror with interface direction; left/right stay physical.

- `width`: `"auto" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "full"`, optional, default `"auto"`.
- `collisionInsets`: `Partial<MapCollisionInsets>`, optional.

  Extra renderer/attribution clearance supplied by the map adapter.

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### MapCollisionInsets

From `@kozmos-ds/product-contracts`.

```ts
interface MapCollisionInsets {
  top: number;
  right: number;
  bottom: number;
  left: number;
}
```
